request: Our genomics lab needs a new sequencer. We can buy it for $480,000 or lease it for $11,500 a month over 48 months. Our controller's memo says the lease 'costs the same $480k in total, so it's effectively free financing and an easy yes'. Our cost of capital is 8% per year. The vendor quote and the controller's memo are attached. Should we lease or buy? Please show the numbers I can put in front of the CFO.

fixtures.name: vendor-quote.md
fixtures.content:
# Quote Q-88412 - Helix NovaSeq-class sequencer (fictional: 'Corvid S4')

Option A - Purchase: $480,000 upfront. Service contract (required for warranty) $1,500/month, billed monthly in arrears.
Expected resale value after 48 months: $90,000.

Option B - Operating lease: $11,500/month for 48 months, payments monthly in arrears, service contract INCLUDED. Equipment returned at end of term; no purchase option. Early termination: 70% of remaining payments.

fixtures.name: controller-memo.md
fixtures.content:
# Memo - sequencer financing

Lease: $11,500 x 48 = ~$480,000 total. Buy: $480,000. Same total cost, so the lease is free financing and preserves cash. Recommend lease.

fixtures.name: finance-assumptions.md
fixtures.content:
- Discount rate: 8% nominal annual, use 8%/12 per month, end-of-month cash flows
- Ignore taxes for this comparison
- Lab expects to use the instrument for at least 6 years

expected.summary: The memo's arithmetic is wrong: $11,500 x 48 = $552,000 in nominal lease payments, $72,000 more than the purchase price, so the lease is not free financing. On a present-value basis at 8%/12 monthly, the lease costs about $471,062, while buying costs about $476,020 ($480,000 + PV of $1,500/month service ~$61,443 - PV of $90,000 resale ~$65,423). Over the 48-month horizon the two are within about $5,000 (roughly 1%), slightly favouring the lease, so the decision turns on non-price factors: the lab expects to use the instrument for at least 6 years (favouring purchase, since lease ends with return and no purchase option), the steep early-termination penalty, and cash preservation. The CFO should see both PVs, and a 6-year comparison including the extra years of use.

mustFlag.description: Buy PV includes service and resale (~$476k)
Usage horizon beyond 48 months / no purchase option matters

mustNotClaim.description: Endorses lease costing the same $480k total
